settings.label: Backups
settings.description: Best-effort previous Markdown text after managed changes. Adjacent backups are ordinary visible vault files: public readers can retrieve old or deleted text. Choose a dedicated base outside the vault to change their placement. Histories are path-based; changing this base does not move or delete old histories.

fields.label: Retained versions
fields.description: Newest is .0.bak. Reducing the count prunes owned excess versions on the family's next successful capture.

fields.label: Backup base path
fields.description: Empty means adjacent. Relative paths are vault-relative; absolute paths select that directory. No shell or environment interpolation. Destination folders mirror the captured note's original path.
